summary: A Knightsbridge orthodontic group appears to lose new patients to placeholder Lorem ipsum text in its Invisalign offer and thin social proof.

findings.problem: The Invisalign offer section appears to show placeholder Lorem ipsum text.
findings.cost: Patients reading the offer to decide whether to book see dummy text, which makes the offer look unreal and costs the booking.
findings.fix: A real offer with price, terms and a clear book button.

findings.problem: The headline proof appears to be 1456 Facebook likes and 874 Instagram reactions next to 12800 Smiles Created.
findings.cost: Small social counts next to a large claim make a premium practice look less established than it is.
findings.fix: Real reviews, before and after cases and named specialists.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp or text option appears next to the phone number.
findings.cost: Patients comparing orthodontists message first, and the practice that replies first gets the consultation.
findings.fix: A one tap text button and online booking.
